message.reasoning:
We need to decide whether to buy Vermont Avenue (light blue) for $100. Player p1 (Alpha) has cash 420, already owns Oriental Avenue and Connecticut Avenue (both light blue). So they own 2 of 3 in group, need one more to have monopoly. Buying Vermont gives monopoly, allowing building houses later. Price $100 is cheap. Opponent Beta has Kentucky and Indiana (orange). Gamma has Reading RR and Electric Company. Delta has none.

Thus buying is beneficial to complete monopoly. Also cash after purchase would be 320, still decent.

Auction could let others get it cheaper? But they likely not want light blue. So buy.

Public message: maybe say "I buy it" or just "I will buy". Could also negotiate? But best to buy.

Make tool call buy_property with private_thought and public_message.

Let's craft concise messages.

function.name: buy_property
function.arguments: {"private_thought": "I own the other two light blue properties. Buying Vermont for $100 completes the monopoly, enabling future house building and rent spikes. I have enough cash (420) to afford it and still have liquidity. No strategic reason to auction; opponents unlikely to value light blue. So I will buy.", "public_message": "I will buy Vermont Avenue."}
